message: Kawaii pastel flood-aware navigation prototype ready. Real cauce router (compare:true; rain policy = hard-block IMEPLAN zonas críticas + underpass sites, soft penalties for observed/hotspot/water layers). ?demo=1 = 28 s loop; window.__cauceDemo {duration_s:28, seek(t)} deterministic; demo routes baked in data/demo-route.json (re-bake: node labs/nav-mochi/tools/bake-demo.mjs). Loads every layer in hazard/index.json; modeled layers get their own rain chip automatically.
